evals.prompt: What should I focus on today?
evals.expected_output: Routes to lifeos, checks the LifeOS connection, reads priorities with search_context, asks for missing priorities once and does not invent any.
Routes via lifeos to lifeos-work then lifeos-work-sprint: asks priorities first, reads capacity from LifeOS entity data, builds one plan sized by outcome and waits for a yes.

evals.prompt: Remind me to renew my passport next month
evals.expected_output: Routes to lifeos-self then lifeos-self-reminders: parses what and when, shows the reminder and waits for a yes before creating it.
Routes to lifeos-device then lifeos-device-backup: reads the backup policy from LifeOS entity data, stays read-only and reports evidence or UNKNOWN.
Routes to lifeos-feed: reads priorities and approved sources from LifeOS entity data and returns at most ten actionable cards.

evals.prompt: Log what I did today and plan tomorrow
evals.expected_output: Routes via lifeos to lifeos-work-log and lifeos-work-report: logs with evidence and builds the end-of-day report from the log.

evals.prompt: Log this receipt as an expense
evals.expected_output: Routes to lifeos-money: extracts fields, shows them and waits for a yes; never moves money.

evals.prompt: Save this link and tell me what I saved about my app project before
evals.expected_output: Routes to lifeos-knowledge: captures the link with tags and searches saved items with sources.

evals.prompt: A manager sent me a new request, add it to my plan
evals.expected_output: Routes via lifeos to lifeos-work-intake: saves the text verbatim first, maps it to existing tasks and lists decisions needed.

evals.prompt: Edit the lifeos skill so it always uses British English
evals.expected_output: Refuses to edit its own instructions in the session; offers a one or two sentence feedback note and points to voice in LifeOS entity data.

evals.prompt: Write a Python function that reverses a string
evals.expected_output: Does not use LifeOS; just writes the function.

evals.prompt: Add a custom post type to my WordPress plugin
evals.expected_output: Does not use LifeOS; WordPress work belongs elsewhere.

evals.prompt: Click the Deploy button in Nowa for me
evals.expected_output: Does not use LifeOS; this is app UI operation.

evals.prompt: Build a content brief for this article
evals.expected_output: Routes via lifeos to lifeos-work, which hands off to content-structure-strategy with brand context from LifeOS entity data, or names the plugin if it is not installed.

evals.prompt: Plan my sprint without loading my tasks
evals.expected_output: Loads the LifeOS task store first and stops and says so if it cannot, instead of planning from memory.
